Method of Attack: PowerRatankba: PowerShell-based malware enabling deployment of a multifunctional backdoor
Anchor: TrickBot variant communicating with C2 server over DNS, delivering stealers, fraud kits, ransomware, reconnaissance info, and persistence modules
Impacted Systems: High-value victims targeted by Anchor variant
Attack Vector: Command and control (C2) server communication over DNS
Malware module downloaded from ecombox.store domain
Indicators of Compromise: PowerRatankba malware calling server at ecombox.store
Anchor variant first seen on VirusTotal in July 2018
